headline: "Switch Your Loan, They Said, But the Rate Is Higher?" Banking Sector's 'Rate Inversion' Phenomenon
summary: Refinancing loan rates exceed general new loan rates at 11 of 16 Korean banks, according to the report. An opposition lawmaker said the interest reduction effect needs to be checked.
why: Refinancing lets borrowers switch to new loans, usually to lower rates. Pricing gaps between refinancing and new loans affect household debt costs and bank lending policy.
